verdict.summary: The change correctly reuses the existing new-crate/stub predicates, evaluates the three reactive rules independently for every added public crate, expands crate-specific routing labels, and suppresses site/guide follow-ons only when corresponding checked-out-tree evidence exists. The focused tests exercise the real evaluator and cover multi-crate emission, stub exclusion, nested manifests, evidence fail-closed behavior, dispatch labels, and deduplication; the focused suite passes (18 tests). No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect requiring changes was found.
